text:
Palladium Price in 2006
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2006, the LBMA palladium price rose 11.6% between 2006-01-31 ($290) and 2006-12-28 ($324). The highest sampled price was $362 in April and the lowest was $286 in February. The mean of these observations was $322. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
